hospitality.ar: في ماليزيا أول شي يُقدَّم للضيف كاسة شاي.
hospitality.en: In Malaysia, the first thing a guest gets is a glass of tea.

hospitality.de: In Malaysia bekommt ein Gast zuerst ein Glas Tee.

hospitality.pt: Na Malásia, a primeira coisa que um convidado recebe é um copo de chá.
hospitality.id: Di Malaysia, tamu pertama-tama disuguhi segelas teh.
hospitality.ms: Di Malaysia, tetamu mula-mula dihidangkan segelas teh.
hospitality.ja: マレーシアではお客さんにまずお茶を一杯出します。
hospitality.fr: Malaisie : la première chose qu'on offre à un invité, c'est un verre de thé.

customs.en: Teh tarik is pulled high between two cups.

architecture: Wooden stilt houses, tall city towers, rainforest and island beaches.
